claim_text: In children aged 2-18 years with NF1 and inoperable symptomatic plexiform neurofibromas, selumetinib 25 mg/m2 every 12 hours produced a confirmed partial response (>=20% target-tumor volume decrease on consecutive MRIs >=3 months apart) in 35 of 50 patients (70%).
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. RTX-KG2 already has CHEBI:90227 treats_or_applied_or_studied_to_treat MONDO:0003304 (2 sources, PMIDs: 32108293, 32187457, 32272491).
source_title: Selumetinib in Children with Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas
